# Support

## Bugs

Use the [bug report form]. Include the `pk` version, operating system, architecture, install method, exact command, and redacted output.

## Feature Requests

Use the [feature request form]. Use [GitHub Discussions] for broad design questions.

## Security

Do not file public issues for vulnerabilities. Follow the [security policy].

[bug report form]: https://github.com/yowainwright/pk/issues/new/choose
[feature request form]: https://github.com/yowainwright/pk/issues/new/choose
[GitHub Discussions]: https://github.com/yowainwright/pk/discussions
[security policy]: SECURITY.md
